title: Takaful Insurance Analytics
thesis: Snowflake delivers Takaful actuarial intelligence — Dynamic Tables aggregate claims and premiums in real-time, ML.FORECAST projects IBNR reserves, and Cortex AI generates underwriting risk assessments from policy documents

talking_points: 200,000 active policies across general, family, and health Takaful lines.
Rp 8.5 trillion in annual contributions — combined ratio at 94.2% (profitable).
Surplus of Rp 490 billion available for participant distribution.
show: Point at 200K policies and Rp 8.5T contributions
tabs.call_out: Rp 8.5T contributions — 94.2% combined ratio, Rp 490B surplus

transition.line: Let's drill into claims patterns by product line.

talking_points: 80,000 claims processed — motor Takaful highest frequency at 12% of policies.
Average settlement time: 14 days for motor, 45 days for health, 90 days for large losses.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flagged 340 claims with fraud indicators for investigation.
show: Show claims frequency by product line
tabs.call_out: 340 claims flagged for fraud — Rp 12B potential savings

transition.line: Fraud detection is working. Let's check reserves.

talking_points: IBNR reserve estimated at Rp 1.2 trillion — 8% above last quarter.
ML.FORECAST projects year-end reserves at Rp 1.4 trillion based on development patterns.
Chain ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson methods compared — BF more conservative by 5%.
show: Display IBNR forecast with methods comparison
tabs.call_out: ML projects Rp 1.4T year-end IBNR — BF method 5% more conservative

transition.line: Now let the Chief Actuary ask about surplus.

talking_points: Wahyu asks: 'How much surplus is available for participant distribution?'
Cortex Analyst calculates — Rp 490B after required reserves and retakaful costs.
Follow-up: 'What's the recommended distribution ratio based on industry practice?' — AI advises.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: actuarial analytics + strategic advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Indonesia's Takaful market growing at 15% CAGR — fastest in ASEAN.
OJK requires Shariah-compliant risk management and surplus distribution.
tabs.call_out: One platform, automated reserving, AI-powered fraud detection

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Takaful insurance.
